messages:
lina_sales: Passing Sycamore (sycamore.ai) to CS — pilot starts 2025-04-12. Deal is signed (12mo), pilot metrics will decide expansion. Needs: Okta SAML + SCIM, VPC peering for logs, possible private deployment later. Legal asked for SOC2 evidence; could delay go-live if not resolved. Please own onboarding, open infra ticket, and confirm owners. Main contacts: Tessa (IT, tessa@sycamore.ai) and finance@sycamore.ai. Raj is primary SE.

raj_se: Adding tech notes: they use Okta with SCIM provisioning. No PII in payloads, just activity metadata. Expected peak ~50 concurrent requests, avg seq length ~600 tokens. Model plan: open-13b quantized. Uploaded Okta metadata to S3 link in email. Example SCIM test curl:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.sycamore.ai/scim/v2/Users
```

emma_cs: Thanks — I'll take onboarding lead. Assigning @emma_cs. I'll schedule kickoff next Tue. Can someone confirm billing contact (we have finance@sycamore.ai) and paste the Okta SAML metadata here if possible?

lina_sales: Billing is finance@sycamore.ai. I copied Okta metadata into the email thread and uploaded the XML to the S3 share: https://s3.company/sycamore/okta_metadata.xml :point_down:

emma_cs: :thumbsup: Creating CS ticket and infra request. Tentative owners: emma_cs (onboarding), theo_support (support triage), kyle_infra (private/dedicated feasibility).

theo_support: Got it — I'll open the support ticket and tag priority 'pilot-go-live'. Any retention or encryption requirements?

raj_se: They asked for 90-day activity log retention and KMS-based encryption (AWS). If we pursue private deployment, HSM/KMS integration will be required.

kyle_infra: I'll scope Dedicated sizing. Rough calc: 50 concurrent qps with 13b quantized suggests starting with 2 medium GPU nodes for canary; will validate once we get sample prompt distribution (p95 seq length).

emma_cs: Next steps (owners):
1) Schedule kickoff with Sycamore + Raj + Emma (by Fri) — Owner: emma_cs
2) CS to pull Okta SAML metadata + confirm billing contact — Owner: emma_cs
3) Support: open infra ticket + set SLA expectations — Owner: theo_support (SUP-8721)
4) Infra: initial sizing + private deploy feasibility — Owner: kyle_infra
5) Enablement: send trial owners a short playbook and monitoring checklist — Owner: emma_cs
I'll update this thread after kickoff.

lina_sales: One more: renewal watch window = 3 months before contract end. Flagging renewal risk if legal drags >6 weeks. Likely expansion if pilot metrics look good.

theo_support: Creating ticket now: SUP-8721. CCing @kyle_infra and @emma_cs. Added labels: okta, kms, pilot-go-live.

emma_cs: Quick ask to infra/eng — can we get a short CSV of sample conversation size distribution (percentiles) so I can configure token caps in the trial UI?

kyle_infra: Will share latency/throughput assumptions and a sample prompt-size distribution doc by EOD. Looping in @sophie_reliability for SLO recommendations.

sophie_reliability: On it. For pilot SLOs recommend p95 inference latency <300ms and p99 <800ms. Fallback policy: route to hosted model variant if Dedicated is degraded. I'll draft the policy.

emma_cs: Perfect. Also need someone to own post-kickoff feedback capture / NPS for pilot.

lina_sales: Looping in @jordan_customer to own feedback/NPS follow-up.

jordan_customer: Happy to own feedback and NPS. I'll prepare 3 focused prompts for quality checks and a short 4-question survey to send at pilot midpoint.

emma_cs: Great — closing the loop for now. I'll post the kickoff invite, CS ticket links, and infra Jira links here once created. :sparkles:
